item.unstable_frontiers.rift_shard.tip0: Use to cross into the Unstable Frontier; use there to return.
item.unstable_frontiers.rift_shard.tip1: Expedition camps lie near where you arrive. Read the journals.
item.unstable_frontiers.rift_shard.tip2: Lost your way? /frontier return takes you home.
item.unstable_frontiers.cage_trophy.tip0: Taken from the guardian of a cage tower or the Hanging Gaol.
item.unstable_frontiers.cage_trophy.tip1: One of the three parts of the Cagewright's Key.
item.unstable_frontiers.rookery_talon.ti: One of the three parts of the Cagewright's Key.
Forges and repairs the Cagewright's Shackle.
item.unstable_frontiers.hive_heart.tip0: Still beating. Cut from the Hive Tyrant.
item.unstable_frontiers.hive_heart.tip1: One of the three parts of the Cagewright's Key.
item.unstable_frontiers.great_cage_heart: What kept the Cagewright's Beast alive.
Builds a Cage Beacon: safe ground in the frontier,
and an anchor your Rift Shard returns you to.
item.unstable_frontiers.cagewright_key.t: Opens the lock of the Great Cage, in the Rustbone Scar.
Use it on the lodestone lock beside the south door.
What is inside wakes when the lock turns.
item.unstable_frontiers.rift_lens.tip0: Use in the frontier to survey the nearest cage, lair and camp.
item.unstable_frontiers.rift_lens.tip1: The Great Cage shows once you carry the Cagewright's Key.
item.unstable_frontiers.cagewright_shack: Use on a hostile creature below a third of its health.
It fights for you for 60 seconds, then crumbles. No bosses.
item.unstable_frontiers.swarmbreaker.tip: Use to Pounce: leap, and land in a shockwave that smashes egg clutches
and staggers the insects it hits. Repair with Cage Trophies.
Three plates over a netherite piece make Gnashback Carapace.
item.unstable_frontiers.shrike_talon.tip: Three talons, a netherite ingot and a stick make the Shrike Impaler.
item.unstable_frontiers.shrike_impaler.t: Double damage to anything in the air.
Drives flyers down; knocks a Shrikewing out of the sky.
item.unstable_frontiers.matriarch_mantle: Works in your hotbar or off hand.
Wingsail: long falls become a glide (sneak to drop). No fall damage.
Brood truce: wild insects leave you be until you strike them.
hint.unstable_frontiers.gnashback: A Gnashback has your scent. When it scrapes the ground, step aside: a charge into a wall or tree stuns it, and its open back takes double damage.
hint.unstable_frontiers.shrikewing: A Shrikewing is circling you. When it screeches, leave the marked spot: a missed dive leaves it climbing slowly or stranded on the ground.
hint.unstable_frontiers.chained_matriarc: The Matriarch: get behind her when the sparks show the scythe arc, keep moving under acid, strike the sac when it opens, and break the pylons to snap her chains.
message.unstable_frontiers.matriarch_fre: The chains snap! She is free, and she can leap.
message.unstable_frontiers.matriarch_bro: She opens her brood sac. Strike it now!
advancement.unstable_frontiers.mantle.de: Take the Matriarch's Mantle from the Great Cage
advancement.unstable_frontiers.gnashback: Take a plate from a Gnashback (let it charge into something hard)
advancement.unstable_frontiers.shrikewin: Take a talon from a Shrikewing
landmark.unstable_frontiers.cage_tower.s: Every cage here was full once.
landmark.unstable_frontiers.cage_tower.c: The cages are empty. The vault is open.
landmark.unstable_frontiers.hive.conquer: The resin wall behind the throne gives way.
landmark.unstable_frontiers.carrion.conq: The feeding is over, for now.
landmark.unstable_frontiers.great_cage.s: The Cagewright built this to hold one thing.
landmark.unstable_frontiers.great_cage.c: The Great Cage is broken. The vault below is open.
zone.unstable_frontiers.brood.start: Break the clutches, or they never stop hatching.
zone.unstable_frontiers.finale.start: The Matriarch wakes. Break the four pylons to snap her chains.
elite.unstable_frontiers.slam.tell: %s rears up. Get out of the ring!
message.unstable_frontiers.sealed: %s is sealed. Clear the rest first (%s).
message.unstable_frontiers.finale_locked: The Great Cage is locked. The Cagewright's Key turns it, at the lodestone by the south door.
message.unstable_frontiers.roster_missin: This fight cannot start: roster '%s' is missing from the mod's data. See latest.log for the fix.
message.unstable_frontiers.roster_unusab: This fight cannot start: roster '%s' needs creatures that are not installed: %s. Install Antarchy 2.2.9 (Integrated Boogaloo 1.0.8) or fix the roster.
message.unstable_frontiers.busy: It waits: too many fights are running on this server.
message.unstable_frontiers.brood_broken: The brood is broken. Nothing more will hatch.
message.unstable_frontiers.key_no_lock: The key fits only the lock of the Great Cage.
message.unstable_frontiers.shield_down: The last pylon falls. It can be hurt now.
message.unstable_frontiers.shielded: The pylons shield it. Break them!
message.unstable_frontiers.problems: Unstable Frontiers found %s data problems (fights that cannot start):
message.unstable_frontiers.shackle_stron: It is too strong yet. Wear it down to a third first.
message.unstable_frontiers.shackle_bound: %s is bound to you for 60 seconds.
message.unstable_frontiers.beacon_anchor: The Cage Beacon holds. Your Rift Shard will bring you here.
message.unstable_frontiers.lens_elsewher: The lens shows only the frontier.
message.unstable_frontiers.lens_clouded: Far off, something vast. The lens clouds over. (Carry the Cagewright's Key.)
message.unstable_frontiers.arrive: The Unstable Frontier. Smoke from an expedition camp, %s blocks to the %s.
message.unstable_frontiers.arrive_none: The Unstable Frontier. No camp in sight; travel and watch the skyline.
message.unstable_frontiers.no_frontier: The frontier dimension is missing (is the data pack disabled?).
message.unstable_frontiers.return_not_he: You are not in the frontier.
message.unstable_frontiers.return_cooldo: The rift is still closing. Try again in %s s.
advancement.unstable_frontiers.root.desc: Craft an Unstable Rift Shard (amethyst shards in the corners, crying obsidian on the sides, an eye of ender in the middle) and use it
advancement.unstable_frontiers.survey.de: Find one of Ilsa Vane's expedition camps, or a Rift Lens
advancement.unstable_frontiers.caged.des: Enter a Gibbet Spire or the Hanging Gaol
advancement.unstable_frontiers.carrion.d: Find a Carrion Field, where the insects and the predators meet
advancement.unstable_frontiers.trophy.de: Defeat a cage's guardian and take its Cage Trophy
advancement.unstable_frontiers.talon.des: Defeat the Rookmother and take a Rookery Talon
advancement.unstable_frontiers.hive_hear: Defeat the Hive Tyrant and take its heart
advancement.unstable_frontiers.swarmbrea: Forge the Swarmbreaker from a Hive Heart
advancement.unstable_frontiers.shackle.d: Forge the Cagewright's Shackle from a Rookery Talon
advancement.unstable_frontiers.key.desc: Join a Cage Trophy, a Rookery Talon and a Hive Heart
advancement.unstable_frontiers.great_cag: Stand in the Rustbone Scar, inside the Great Cage
advancement.unstable_frontiers.cage_hear: Break the pylons and kill the Chained Matriarch
item.unstable_frontiers.focusing_lens.ti: One of the rift engine's three components.
Set it into the engine at the observatory's heart.
item.unstable_frontiers.coolant_heart.ti: One of the rift engine's three components.
Still cold. Set it into the engine.
item.unstable_frontiers.star_chart.tip0: One of the rift engine's three components.
item.unstable_frontiers.star_chart.tip1: It shows a sky that is not this one.
item.unstable_frontiers.astrolabe.tip0: In the frontier: use to find the nearest Rift Observatory.
item.unstable_frontiers.astrolabe.tip1: In the Astral Abyss: hold it to see the way to a place; use to pick the next.
item.unstable_frontiers.astrolabe.tip2: Sneak and use to list every place and its state.
item.unstable_frontiers.sigil_shard.tip0: Three, with an eye of ender, make an Eclipse Sigil.
item.unstable_frontiers.sigil_shard.tip1: One waits at each of the abyss's places: the Starwell, the Archive, the Tether Spire.
item.unstable_frontiers.eclipse_sigil.ti: Set it into the altar of the Hollow Crown.
Prepare first. What answers is very large.
Forges Eclipse Sigils (with a Lumen Core) and repairs the Blinkstone.
item.unstable_frontiers.lumen_core.tip0: From Orrery Wardens (and rarely Lumen Mites).
item.unstable_frontiers.eclipse_scale.ti: Sneak-use the Corona with a scale in your off hand to empower it; also repairs it.
item.unstable_frontiers.blinkstone.tip0: Use to step up to 10 blocks the way you look, through the air.
item.unstable_frontiers.blinkstone.tip1: Never into a block. 3 s between steps. Repair with Starmetal.
item.unstable_frontiers.corona.tip0: Light stored: %s / %s. Each melee hit stores one.
item.unstable_frontiers.corona.tip1: Use to release it all as a piercing beam (10 per charge).
item.unstable_frontiers.corona.tip2: Tier %s of 3. Sneak-use with an Eclipse Scale in the off hand to raise it.
item.unstable_frontiers.rift_lens.tip2: Once the Great Cage has fallen, it also finds the Rift Observatories.
landmark.unstable_frontiers.rift_observa: Something was watched from here. Then something came through.
The engine's three components are recovered. Set them into it.
landmark.unstable_frontiers.abyss_landin: The rift set you down here. The gate behind you leads back.
A fragment of the world the observatory watched.
landmark.unstable_frontiers.hollow_crown: The Leviathan sleeps below. The altar wakes it.
message.unstable_frontiers.engine_has: That part is already in place.
message.unstable_frontiers.engine_progre: The engine takes the part. %s of 3.
message.unstable_frontiers.engine_needs: The rift engine is dark. It still needs: %s.
message.unstable_frontiers.engine_active: The rift engine hums. The gate beside it stands open to the Astral Abyss.
message.unstable_frontiers.rift_open_sub: The gate stands open to the Astral Abyss, and stays open.
message.unstable_frontiers.rift_no_gate: The engine woke, but no gate answered (was the gate frame broken?).
message.unstable_frontiers.no_abyss: The Astral Abyss is missing (is the data pack disabled?).
message.unstable_frontiers.abyss_welcome: The Astral Abyss. The gate behind you leads back. Fall too far and the rift will catch you, at a price. Follow the beams in the sky: the abyss's places hold Sigil Shards, and three make the Eclipse Sigil.
message.unstable_frontiers.rift_catch: The rift catches you, and takes its due.
message.unstable_frontiers.abyss_belongi: Your belongings wait in the Astral Abyss at %s %s %s. They keep for fifteen minutes.
message.unstable_frontiers.eclipse_altar: An empty socket the shape of a sigil. The Leviathan has fallen %s times.
message.unstable_frontiers.eclipse_rises: The Crown shakes. Something vast rises from the void below.
message.unstable_frontiers.eclipse_sinks: The Leviathan sinks back into the void. The altar stays charged: the next call costs no sigil.
message.unstable_frontiers.eclipse_falls: The Eclipse Leviathan falls. The sky over the Crown clears.
message.unstable_frontiers.astrolabe_non: The astrolabe finds no observatory within reach.
message.unstable_frontiers.astrolabe_els: The astrolabe's rings spin aimlessly here.
message.unstable_frontiers.corona_empty: The Corona holds no light. Strike something first.
message.unstable_frontiers.corona_max: The Corona can hold no more.
boss.unstable_frontiers.leviathan.beam: Its corona flares: get behind an obelisk, or off the line of light!
boss.unstable_frontiers.leviathan.well: Rings close around you: step out of yours!
boss.unstable_frontiers.leviathan.pass: A trail of soul fire: it will sweep along it. Then strike it low!
boss.unstable_frontiers.leviathan.eclips: The eclipse: it will crash down in the ring of fire. Then its core lies open!
boss.unstable_frontiers.leviathan.phase2: The Leviathan roars. Its beam now sweeps back again, and it calls its mites.
boss.unstable_frontiers.leviathan.phase3: The Leviathan roars. The eclipse is coming: more wells, and it will crash down and lie open.
hint.unstable_frontiers.lumen_mite: Lumen Mites: when a mite's lantern swells, it spits a slow bolt. Step aside; they are fragile up close.
hint.unstable_frontiers.orrery_warden: An Orrery Warden: when its rings stop and its lens flares, break line of sight. After the beam its rings stall: hit it then (double damage).
advancement.unstable_frontiers.observato: Find a Rift Observatory in the frontier
advancement.unstable_frontiers.component: Recover the Focusing Lens, the Coolant Heart and the Star Chart
advancement.unstable_frontiers.abyss.des: Restore the rift engine and step into the Astral Abyss
advancement.unstable_frontiers.blinkston: Take the Blinkstone from the Starwell
advancement.unstable_frontiers.sigil.des: Join three Sigil Shards with an eye of ender
advancement.unstable_frontiers.leviathan: Defeat the Eclipse Leviathan at the Hollow Crown
advancement.unstable_frontiers.starmetal: Smelt Starmetal mined from the abyss's islands
Wear (head curio slot, or helmet slot) to see much further under water.
Through them, the surveyors' tide glyphs glow along the routes.
item.unstable_frontiers.deep_sight_goggl: Further sight still, even in the trench.
Hostile creatures within 16 blocks glow while you are under water.
item.unstable_frontiers.diving_rig.tip0: Wear (back curio slot, or chest slot). Breathes for you under water.
item.unstable_frontiers.diving_rig.tip1: Refills in open air, faster in the Drowned Expanse, fastest over a Breath Vent.
item.unstable_frontiers.diving_rig.tip2: Below y 100 in the Expanse it drains three times as fast.
item.unstable_frontiers.deep_rig.tip0: Seven minutes of air, and no extra drain in the deep.
item.unstable_frontiers.swim_fins.tip0: Wear (feet curio slot, or boots slot): much faster swimming.
item.unstable_frontiers.breath_charm.tip: Wear (necklace curio slot): you breathe water, anywhere.
The tide gate accepts it in place of a rig.
item.unstable_frontiers.echo_sounder.tip: In the Drowned Expanse: hold it to see the way and depth to a charted place.
Use to pick the next charted place; sneak and use to list them all.
Places are charted when you reach them, or when a fight ahead of them is won.
item.unstable_frontiers.pressure_valve.t: From Deepwork Station. Half of a Deep Rig.
Craft with a Diving Rig and a Keel Plate.
item.unstable_frontiers.keel_plate.tip0: From the Wreckmaw. The other half of a Deep Rig.
item.unstable_frontiers.keel_plate.tip1: Craft with a Diving Rig and a Pressure Valve.
item.unstable_frontiers.choir_pearl.tip1: Craft into Abyssal Goggles (with a glow ink sac) for Deep-Sight Goggles.
item.unstable_frontiers.abyssal_pearl.ti: From the Deepcaller. Repairs the Undertow.
Three, with a heart of the sea or an eclipse scale, make a Breath Charm.
item.unstable_frontiers.undertow.tip0: Use: cast a 24-block line. A creature is dragged to you; a wall drags you to it.
item.unstable_frontiers.undertow.tip1: Strikes harder against creatures in water or of the sea.
item.unstable_frontiers.undertow.tip2: Works anywhere: the frontier's cliffs, the Abyss's islands. Bosses cannot be dragged.
item.unstable_frontiers.rift_lens.tip3: It also finds the Sunken Gates, the way into the Drowned Expanse.
A flooded stair. The gate at the bottom wants divers, not swimmers.
landmark.unstable_frontiers.drowned_stat: Ring the bell to make this shelter yours.
landmark.unstable_frontiers.drowned_plac: Cleared. The way onward is charted.
landmark.unstable_frontiers.drowned_vaul: The Deepcaller sleeps under the dome. The abyssal bell wakes it.
message.unstable_frontiers.tide_gate_ref: The tide gate will not open: %s
message.unstable_frontiers.need_both: you need Abyssal Goggles and a Diving Rig (or a Breath Charm) worn, not carried.
message.unstable_frontiers.need_rig: you need a Diving Rig (or a Breath Charm) worn, not carried.
message.unstable_frontiers.need_goggles: you need Abyssal Goggles worn, not carried.
message.unstable_frontiers.no_drowned: The Drowned Expanse is missing (is the data pack disabled?).
message.unstable_frontiers.drowned_welco: The Drowned Expanse. You stand in Tidewatch Station's air dome; the gate here leads back. Your rig breathes for you: watch the gauge, and refill over Breath Vents or in a dome. Ring the tide bell to make a shelter yours: if you black out, the tide returns you to it. Hold the echo sounder to find the charted stations.
message.unstable_frontiers.bell_new: You ring the bell of %s. This shelter is yours now: black out, and the tide brings you back here.
message.unstable_frontiers.bell_rung: You ring the bell of %s again. Shelter set.
message.unstable_frontiers.bell_list: Other bells you have rung: %s. Sneak and ring to travel to the next.
message.unstable_frontiers.drowned_rescu: Everything goes dark... The tide carries you back to your shelter.
message.unstable_frontiers.drowned_belon: Your belongings sank in the Drowned Expanse at %s %s %s. They keep for fifteen minutes and do not drift.
message.unstable_frontiers.rig_10: Rig: 10 seconds of air left! Surface or find a vent.
message.unstable_frontiers.rig_empty: Your rig is empty. You are holding your breath now: get to air, a vent or a dome.
message.unstable_frontiers.deep_line: Below the deep line (y 100) your diving rig drains three times as fast. A Deep Rig would not.
message.unstable_frontiers.sounder_elsew: The echo sounder only answers in the Drowned Expanse.
message.unstable_frontiers.ray_content: The lanternray eats, content. There is nowhere left it can lead you.
message.unstable_frontiers.ray_leads: The lanternray flashes and turns: follow it.
message.unstable_frontiers.deepcaller_ri: The bell's note goes down and down. Something answers from below the dome.
message.unstable_frontiers.deepcaller_si: The Deepcaller sinks back into the dark. Ring the bell again when you are ready.
boss.unstable_frontiers.deepcaller.lure: Its lure brightens: look away or put stone between you!
boss.unstable_frontiers.deepcaller.charg: It coils: get off its line, and let it hit the dome wall!
boss.unstable_frontiers.deepcaller.vorte: The water turns: swim outward, away from it!
boss.unstable_frontiers.deepcaller.phase: The Deepcaller roars. It charges twice now, and calls its brood.
hint.unstable_frontiers.murkjaw: A Murkjaw: when its jaw unhinges and bubbles mark a line, swim off the line. A miss into a wall stuns it (double damage).
hint.unstable_frontiers.lanternray: Lanternrays are harmless. Feed one glow berries and it leads you to a place you have not charted.
advancement.unstable_frontiers.sunken_ga: Find a Sunken Gate in the frontier (a Rift Lens points to one)
advancement.unstable_frontiers.diving_ge: Craft Abyssal Goggles and a Diving Rig (both need a Gnashback plate)
advancement.unstable_frontiers.drowned.d: Pass the tide gate wearing goggles and a rig
Build a Deep Rig from Deepwork's valve and the Wreckmaw's keel plate
advancement.unstable_frontiers.deep_sigh: Make Deep-Sight Goggles from a Choir Pearl
advancement.unstable_frontiers.deepcalle: Ring the abyssal bell and defeat the Deepcaller
advancement.unstable_frontiers.breath_ch: Make a Breath Charm and never need the rig again
place.unstable_frontiers.wreck: the Wreck of the Long Patience
Shrikewing screeches: it is about to dive
